sentenceSets.sentence: The contract was antedated to avoid the newly enacted tax law, a fraud the court found immediately.

answerChoices.reasoning: Falsified means made false or altered dishonestly, which the contract was, but doesn't specifically mean changing the date.
Backdated means assigned a date earlier than actual, nearly identical to antedated, but may suggest less formal terminology.
Predated means existed before in time, which the false date suggests, but doesn't convey deliberate date manipulation.
Forged means created fraudulently, which the contract was, but doesn't specifically address the date manipulation aspect.
Tampered means made unauthorized changes to, which was done to the contract, but doesn't specifically mean changing the date.
Altered means changed or modified, which the contract was, but doesn't specifically mean the date was changed.
Modified means changed in some way, which the contract was, but doesn't specifically indicate date manipulation.
Counterfeited means made an illegal copy of, which the contract essentially was, but doesn't specifically mean the date was false.
Validated means confirmed or verified as genuine, opposite to deliberately falsifying a contract with fraudulent dating.
Authenticated means confirmed as genuine, opposite to the fraudulent antedating the court discovered.
Executed means carried out or put into effect, which the contract was, but opposite to the sense of fraudulently changing dates.
